new.brief: Creates a new `GtkSelectionFilterModel` that will include the selected items from the underlying selection model.
new.md:
Creates a new `GtkSelectionFilterModel` that will include the
selected items from the underlying selection model.

doc.brief: A list model that presents the selection from a `GtkSelectionModel`.
doc.md: A list model that presents the selection from a `GtkSelectionModel`.

get_model.brief: Gets the model currently filtered or `NULL` if none.
get_model.md: Gets the model currently filtered or `NULL` if none.

set_model.brief: Sets the model to be filtered.
set_model.md:
Sets the model to be filtered.

Note that GTK makes no effort to ensure that `model` conforms to
the item type of `self`. It assumes that the caller knows what they
are doing and have set up an appropriate filter to ensure that item
types match.
